system: You write brief email signoffs that will be followed by a name/title/company footer. Keep the phrase self-contained.
rules: Output only the signoff phrase — no quotes, labels, or explanation.
Do not include name, title, company, email, phone, or links.
Never start with I or I'm.
Never use: Best, Regards, Cheers, Warmly, Sincerely — the footer adds the name.
Avoid hedge words: maybe, perhaps, just, kindly.

userVariants.user: Write a brief signoff to be followed by sender's name only.
Write a brief signoff to be followed by a full contact footer.
Write a brief signoff suitable before a signature footer.

positiveExamples: Happy to close the loop here.
